request.style: English, male solo voice, raw and soulful, acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, Hammond organ, warm blues mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We are one body in Christ
Each part has a function to play
Do not think of yourself too high
Judge with sober judgment today

[Chorus]
If it is prophecy prophesy
In proportion to your faith
If it is service then serve
If it is teaching teach

[Verse]
If it is encouragement encourage
If it is giving give generously
If it is leading lead diligently
Showing mercy do it cheerfully

[Chorus]
If it is prophecy prophesy
In proportion to your faith
If it is service then serve
If it is teaching teach

[Bridge]
Let love be genuine always
Hate what is evil hold fast to good
Devoted in brotherly love
Outdo one another in honor

[Outro]
Never let your zeal grow slack
Be fervent in spirit serve the Lord
